title: pleopeltis xantholepis
intro: Pleopeltis xantholepis, commonly known as the yellow-leaved polypody, is a species of epiphytic fern found in tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis xantholepis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties, and even show potential in cancer prevention. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
